description: The outreach log on one person, newest first: every logged contact with who reached out, the channel (email, x, linkedin, bluesky, reddit, github, call, meeting, other), when, and a short note. Check it, and the person's outreach owner, before reaching out so two teammates never contact the same person without knowing. With groupId, the log that keyword group keeps on them.

groupId.description: Scope to one keyword group (grp_...): only people who mentioned that group's keywords, with that group's own tags, notes, mute, merges, activities and segments. Omit for the whole workspace.

id.description: Audience author id (aut_...), from list_people or a mention's authorId
